name: factory-band
description: Experimental. A band above the prompt for a factory run: each worker's worktree state, model and effort, the workers' belt denies, belt-inbox items for this session, and a weave now button.

events.title: Read the events service
events.description: Ask the local events service for belt's ledger (the workers' auto-mode denials, effort) and belt-inbox (items addressed to this session). Off counts the workers' guard denials only and shows inbox as a dash.

contractGuard.title: Contract guard
contractGuard.description: Deny a factory worker spawn whose prompt does not open with the eight-line task header. Off by default; belt stays the guard.
